text: Testing plays an important role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of code, while integration tests make sure different parts work together correctly. Many developers use test-driven development, which means they write tests before writing the actual code. This approach helps them think carefully about what the code should do. When tests pass, developers feel more confident that their software works as expected. Tests also make it easier to find and fix problems early, before they become bigger issues. In short, good testing saves time and helps teams build reliable software that users can trust.
